# `opense4.view`

The view: what one empire knows of the game (docs/sdk/view.md), as typed objects.

`View(data)` wraps the view map the engine sends without copying or converting it: every list and index is built the first time it is used, and each object reads its fields when asked, so wrapping even a large view costs next to nothing.

Conventions (docs/sdk/python-api.md, "The view"):

- Every documented field is a property with the docs' name: `vehicle.name`, `colony.population`.
- A field that holds an id gives the object it names, and the id itself under the same name with `_id`: `vehicle.design` is a Design, `vehicle.design_id` its id; `fleet.members` gives Vehicles, `fleet.member_ids` their ids. A `... ref` or `... index` field stays a number (a ref may name what the view does not list; an index is a position in the rules view).
- `record.raw` is the map as the engine sent it, `record["field"]` one field of it.
- Objects with an id (empires, systems, stellar objects, colonies, vehicles, fleets, designs, messages) are equal when their ids are, and can be dict keys.

Source: [python/opense4/view.py](../../../python/opense4/view.py). Index: [the API reference](README.md).

Contents: [`View`](#view), [`Game`](#game), [`MyEmpire`](#myempire), [`Empire`](#empire), [`System`](#system), [`SpaceObject`](#spaceobject), [`Colony`](#colony), [`Vehicle`](#vehicle), [`Fleet`](#fleet), [`Design`](#design), [`Message`](#message), [`Location`](#location), [`Resources`](#resources), [`Battle`](#battle), [`record`](#record).

## `View`

```python
View(data: Dict[str, Any], rules: Any = None)
```

One empire's view of the game (docs/sdk/view.md, `view`).

Lists: `empires`, `systems`, `objects`, `colonies`, `vehicles`, `fleets`, `designs`, `messages`, `log`, `battles`. Lookups by id: `empire(id)`, `system(id)`, `object(id)`, `colony(planet)`, `vehicle(id)`, `fleet(id)`, `design(id)`, `message(id)`; each takes an id or an object and gives None for what the view does not list. `my` is our own affairs, `me` our Empire, `galaxy` the warp map, `rules` the rules view.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `api` | `int` | The SDK's interface version: 1. |
| `me` | `Optional[Empire]` | Whose view this is. |
| `empire_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `me`. |
| `whole` | `bool` | Built from the whole state. |
| `game` | `Game` | The game: turn, date, options. |
| `my` | `Optional[MyEmpire]` | The empire's own affairs (null for a spectator). |
| `empires` | `List["Empire"]` | Every empire, as known. |
| `systems` | `List["System"]` | Every system; the contents of explored ones. |
| `objects` | `List["SpaceObject"]` | The stellar objects of the systems whose contents are shown. |
| `colonies` | `List["Colony"]` | Our colonies, and the foreign ones we know. |
| `vehicles` | `List["Vehicle"]` | Our vehicles, and the foreign ones we see. |
| `fleets` | `List["Fleet"]` | Our fleets. |

## `Game`

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `turn` | `int` | Turns played; the date is 2400 plus a tenth of a year a turn. |

| `game_over` | `bool` | The game has ended. |

| `winner_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `winner`. |
| `peaceful_turns` | `int` | The peace victory's counter. |
| `options` | `GameOptions` | The options that matter for play. |
| `victory` | `VictoryConditions` | The victory conditions. |

| `leader` | `Optional[Vehicle]` | The member that leads now. |
| `leader_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `leader`. |
| `chosen_leader` | `Optional[Vehicle]` | The leader chosen with set_fleet_leader, if any. |
| `chosen_leader_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `chosen_leader`. |
| `location` | `Location` | Where it is. |
| `formation` | `int` | Its formation. |
| `strategy` | `int` | Its strategy (a position in its owner's strategies). |
| `experience` | `int` | Its experience. |
| `minister` | `bool` | Under minister control. |
| `speed` | `int` | The lowest full movement among the members with it. |
| `orders` | `List[Order]` | Its orders. |
| `repeat_orders` | `bool` | They repeat. |
| `vehicles` | `List["Vehicle"]` | Its members (as `members`). |
| `system` | `Optional["System"]` | The system it is in. |
| `idle` | `bool` | It has no orders. |

## `Design`

A design: ours, or a foreign one we know.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|

| `owner` | `Optional[Empire]` | Its owner. |
| `owner_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `owner`. |
| `known` | `bool` | We know its parts. |
| `name` | `Optional[str]` | Its name. |
| `design_type` | `Optional[str]` | Its type. |
| `hull` | `int` | Its hull. |
| `picture` | `str` | Its own picture's base name, empty for its hull's (how its ships look, so it shows for every design). |
| `entries` | `Optional[List[DesignEntry]]` | Its components. |
| `strategy` | `int` | Its vehicles' combat strategy. |
| `obsolete` | `bool` | Obsolete. |
| `created_turn` | `int` | When it was made. |
| `template_name` | `Optional[str]` | The computer designer's template it came from. |
| `prototype` | `Optional[bool]` | Nothing of it was built yet. |
| `built` | `Optional[int]` | Vehicles built. |
| `lost` | `Optional[int]` | Vehicles lost. |
| `scrapped` | `Optional[int]` | Vehicles scrapped. |
| `enemy_tonnage_destroyed` | `Optional[int]` | Tonnage of enemies its vehicles destroyed. |
| `seen_turn` | `Optional[int]` | A foreign design: the turn we last saw it. |
| `figures` | `Optional[DesignFigures]` | What the designer shows of it. |
| `mine` | `bool` | It is ours. |
| `vehicle_type` | `Optional[str]` | What its hull builds (from its figures), when known. |

## `Message`

A diplomatic message.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Optional[int]` | Its id (set by the engine). |
| `from_empire` | `Optional[Empire]` | The sender (set by the engine). |
| `from_empire_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `from_empire`. |
| `to_empire` | `Optional[Empire]` | The recipient. |
| `to_empire_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `to_empire`. |
| `sent_turn` | `int` | When it was sent. |
| `type` | `str` | What kind of message. |
| `tone` | `int` | 0 pleading, 1 neutral (the default), 2 demanding. |
| `text` | `str` | What it says. |
| `treaty` | `str` | The treaty proposed, accepted or broken (none by default). |
| `offer` | `List[PackageItem]` | What the sender gives. |
| `request` | `List[PackageItem]` | What the sender asks for. |
| `third_empire` | `Optional[Empire]` | The empire a request is about. |

| `planet` | `Optional[int]` | The planet a demand or request names. |
| `in_reply_to` | `Optional[int]` | The message it answers. |
| `delivered` | `bool` | It reached the recipient. |
| `answered` | `bool` | It was answered. |
| `dated` | `int` | The turn of its entry in the recipient's log. |

## `Location`

A sector of a system. Equal to another location of the same sector, and usable as a dict key.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `system` | `Optional[System]` | The system (null: no place). |
| `system_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `system`. |
| `x` | `int` | Column, 0 to 12 left to right (6 by default). |
| `y` | `int` | Row, 0 to 12 top to bottom; (6, 6) is the centre (6 by default). |
| `sector` | `Tuple[int, int]` | (x, y). |

### `Location.distance_to`

```python
distance_to(other: Any) -> Optional[int]
```

Sectors between here and another place in the same system (moves, diagonals counting one), or None in another system.

### `Resources.as_tuple`

```python
as_tuple() -> Tuple[int, int, int]
```

```python
covers(cost: Any) -> bool
```

## `record`

```python
record(kind: str, data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], view: Any = None) -> Any
```

A record of the documented type `kind` ("path_result", "location"...) over `data`, resolving its ids in `view` (or nowhere).
